ALARM.source_order: Descriptive speaker/command depth, not recognition quality or an ablation winner
ALARM.targeted_followup: Review ambiguous meridiem/time wording and preserve quiet final AM/PM. Fill missing clock-cell speakers using new recordings, not metadata defaults.

BRIGHTNESS.source_order: Descriptive speaker/command depth, not recognition quality or an ablation winner
BRIGHTNESS.targeted_followup: Prioritize review of dim/deem/green-like ASR wording; never infer a brightness verb from its prompt. Add connected 20/60/100 percent and named-target combinations.

CALL.source_order: Descriptive speaker/command depth, not recognition quality or an ablation winner
CALL.targeted_followup: Six recovered unknown/incomplete-contact requests teach rejection, not Home/Mom recognition. Human development and calibration CALL positives remain absent.

COLOR.source_order: Descriptive speaker/command depth, not recognition quality or an ablation winner
COLOR.targeted_followup: Review activation-versus-color ambiguity before correction. Preserve two-word colors and target labels; existing joint color/room gaps remain.

CREATE_REMINDER.source_order: Descriptive speaker/command depth, not recognition quality or an ablation winner
CREATE_REMINDER.targeted_followup: Review finite task content without erasing arbitrary dictated text or dates. Human calibration remains empty; collect independent approved task commands.

LIGHT_OFF.source_order: Descriptive speaker/command depth, not recognition quality or an ablation winner
LIGHT_OFF.targeted_followup: Review the remaining off/target references and fill scarce kitchen/bathroom speaker cells; do not change evaluation membership.

LIGHT_ON.source_order: Descriptive speaker/command depth, not recognition quality or an ablation winner
LIGHT_ON.targeted_followup: Retain the corrected generic=0/named=1 target convention. Two lexical-recovered out-of-catalog requests supervise rejection only; review the remaining targets without inventing aliases.

LIST_REMINDERS.source_order: Descriptive speaker/command depth, not recognition quality or an ablation winner
LIST_REMINDERS.targeted_followup: Review list/show/read references without converting creation or unsupported list scopes. Original-human calibration positives remain absent.

MESSAGE.source_order: Descriptive speaker/command depth, not recognition quality or an ablation winner
MESSAGE.targeted_followup: No omitted MESSAGE candidate exists in this pool, and train/dev/calibration positives remain zero. Collect genuine empty-slot requests; never strip a recipient/body to fabricate one.

NEXT.source_order: Descriptive speaker/command depth, not recognition quality or an ablation winner
NEXT.targeted_followup: Review next/skip versus play-next wording; preserve the cue and final consonants rather than collapsing to generic playback.

PAUSE.source_order: Descriptive speaker/command depth, not recognition quality or an ablation winner
PAUSE.targeted_followup: Four original audiobook recordings from two declared speakers now supervise intent only. Add no guessed audiobook phones; review remaining pause semantics separately from stop.

PLAY_MUSIC.source_order: Descriptive speaker/command depth, not recognition quality or an ablation winner
PLAY_MUSIC.targeted_followup: Seven recovered metadata-supported unknown-name/artist requests are rejection supervision, not named-music positives. Review the remaining request before collecting approved title and artist speech.

STOP.source_order: Descriptive speaker/command depth, not recognition quality or an ablation winner
STOP.targeted_followup: No omitted original-human STOP rows were found. Retain short utterances and collect independent stop/pause, negation and quoted-speech contrasts.

TEMPERATURE.source_order: Descriptive speaker/command depth, not recognition quality or an ablation winner
TEMPERATURE.targeted_followup: The two omitted training examples are ASR-derived incomplete-wording cases, not extra speakers or validated set commands. Collect independent Celsius commands and human calibration.

TIME.source_order: Descriptive speaker/command depth, not recognition quality or an ablation winner
TIME.targeted_followup: Adjudicate omitted time queries including extra context; preserve the whole short query and distinguish alarm/timer requests.

TIMER.source_order: Descriptive speaker/command depth, not recognition quality or an ablation winner
TIMER.targeted_followup: Keep all six conflicting one-hour-plus-one-minute (3660-second) transcripts versus one-minute metadata untrained until two listeners agree; retain units and internal pauses.

UNKNOWN.source_order: Descriptive speaker/command depth, not recognition quality or an ablation winner
UNKNOWN.targeted_followup: Twenty-two original dataset-label negatives now supervise intent without CTC targets. Ninety unintelligible training clips remain ambiguous, not extra true negatives; eleven no-speaker silence rows remain reserved metadata-only.

VOLUME.source_order: Descriptive speaker/command depth, not recognition quality or an ablation winner
VOLUME.targeted_followup: Review operation/value ambiguity with explicit up/down/mute/set strata. Missing connected absolute values and mute positives still require human recordings.

WEATHER.source_order: Descriptive speaker/command depth, not recognition quality or an ablation winner
WEATHER.targeted_followup: Review the training wording/semantic queue without treating every omitted weather row as valid or lowering a test-selected threshold; diversify independent calibration speakers.

evaluation_limits.note: Do not infer causal source quality from development-source differences or select per-intent winning models to fabricate a hybrid. Existing models have synthetic-training exposure.

feature_integrity.interpretation: Source mean offsets are diagnostics relative to the 1889-human candidate normalization, not proof of a causal preprocessing defect.

desktop_replay_timing_ms.scope: One pass on CPU, 2 ONNX threads/1 BLAS thread; includes frontend/decoder/policy, excludes file IO, live speech and endpoint waiting; not Pi timing.

compact-v7-existing-relaxed.interpretation: Development diagnostics on an already-trained checkpoint; not a new data treatment effect or blind qualification.
